### The matchThe match

It was not an easy journey for Türkiye to reach the FIFA World Cup 2026™, having gone through the European play-offs, but it was certainly worth the wait and now they find themselves in a scintillating group stage finale against host nation USA at glittering Los Angeles Stadium. It will be the first World Cup meeting between the two nations.

The winner of Group D will meet a third-place team from Group B, E, F, I or J at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium on 1 July. The group runner-up will face the Group G runner-up at Dallas Stadium on 3 July, while the Group D third-place finisher could potentially face the winner of Group E, I or K.

[...]
Los Angeles Stadium is the newest venue chosen to host FIFA World Cup 2026, having opened in September 2020. It is situated just a 30-minute drive from Pasadena's famous Rose Bowl, which hosted the World Cup final of 1994. Both the Los Angeles Rams and Los Angeles Chargers play their NFL fixtures at the venue, which also hosted Super Bowl LVI as the Rams defeated the Cincinnati Bengals 23-20 in 2022. Los Angeles Stadium has already hosted a number of concerts under its iconic and unique roof, with Taylor Swift, BTS and Ed Sheeran among the artists to have graced the venue. ## Team Profiles
[...]
High press, physically dominant midfield, direct in transition. More comfortable attacking on the counter than controlling possession. Set pieces are a genuine weapon. Home crowd in every group match is a real X factor — all group games on American soil.
[...]
USMNT under Mauricio Pochettino plays a compact 4-3-3 that transitions to 4-2-3-1 in possession. Best when pressing and exploiting space on the counter. Weakest when forced to break down a parked bus — lacks the creative midfield to unlock low blocks. The 2026 advantage: all group matches on American soil. Historical data says host nations advance from groups 85% of the time. This squad is better than the sum of its parts when the crowd is behind them.
[...]
Türkiye qualified via UEFA Playoff C, beating Kosovo 1-0. Under coach Vincenzo Montella, they play an attacking 4-2-3-1 built around two exceptional playmakers: Arda Güler (Real Madrid) and Hakan Çalhanoglu (Inter). Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is the goal threat — a 7.66 season rating and relentless work rate in the box. Türkiye's ceiling is an R16 or QF run. Their group draw — USA, Paraguay, Australia — is very winnable. Totals: OVER in attack-heavy matchups.
[...]
Türkiye is the most dangerous of the six playoff qualifiers. Their group (USA, Paraguay, Australia) is beatable. If Güler and Çalhanoglu are both fit and in form, Turkey can advance. The R16 is their realistic ceiling — they'd face a second-place Group C finisher, likely a manageable draw. Arda Güler is the X-factor: when he plays freely and isn't double-marked, Turkey becomes a completely different team. Watch his early form in the group for R16 handicap bets.
[...]
United States and Türkiye meet in Group D at the 2026 FIFA World Cup on 2026-06-25 at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles. Our simulation gives United States a clear edge — a 16-point win probability gap separating these sides. United States enters with a 88.5% advancement probability in our model vs Türkiye at 70.1%. The Over 2.5 goals is our primary market play. The combined attacking profiles of these sides project to a high-scoring affair. Both Teams to Score is also in play — both sides have real scoring threats that should test the opposing defense. Top value play: USA to win.
